title: Claude for Long-Horizon Tasks — Lance Martin, Anthropic
talk_summary: Anthropic's Lance Martin describes four architectural themes for long-horizon async agents: decoupling the harness ('brain') from sandboxes ('hands') via an append-only session log, using independent verifier contexts in build/verify loops, in-band memory writing plus offline 'dreaming' consolidation, and org-level multiplayer harnesses.

takeaways.technique: Independent verifier context in build/verify loop
takeaways.what_they_do: Run a separate verifier agent with its own context window and rubric that grades the builder's output, looping until the verifier confirms the outcome, rather than asking the builder to grade itself.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it's quite effective to separate verification into a separate context window

takeaways.technique: Decouple harness from execution sandbox via append-only session log
takeaways.what_they_do: Keep the agent harness stateless, persist all state in an append-only event log, and run work in disposable sandboxes so harness or container death doesn't lose the session; credentials live in a separate vault.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the harness becomes a stateless process that talks to a session. The session is an append-only event log

takeaways.technique: Append-only immutable context object the model can re-fetch
takeaways.what_they_do: Instead of destructive compaction that discards context, keep the full session log immutable and let the model query back into old context when needed.
takeaways.evidence_quote: the context object is persistent and is unadulterated. So, it's append-only. And the model can always go back and fetch old context

takeaways.technique: In-band memory writing on a general substrate, no prescribed schema
takeaways.what_they_do: Give the model simple file/db write tools and let it decide what to store and how to structure memory, rather than imposing a fixed memory schema.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Let the model structure and maintain its own memory. Don't give it a prescribed memory schema.

takeaways.what_they_do: An out-of-band job reviews prior sessions and the memory store to find and correct incorrect or locally-optimal memories that got stuck.
takeaways.evidence_quote: dreaming is is kind of an offline or out of band process that we've used to consolidate and improve memory
takeaways.numbers: 5/5 replicates fell into trap with raw memory; dreaming corrected it

takeaways.technique: Org-level multiplayer harness with proactive alerts
takeaways.what_they_do: A shared harness with its own identity and org-wide context that many users/agents steer concurrently, configured to proactively surface things worth knowing rather than only reacting.
takeaways.evidence_quote: it is a harness that everyone in the organization has access to and can use. So, it is a multiplayer harness.
